messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | External Affairs, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear ALKAFAA Recruitment Team,

I am sharing my executive profile for senior opportunities in Saudi Arabia spanning external and corporate affairs, government relations, ESG and sustainability, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and country-facing leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, executive communications and cross-functional execution within a major industrial mining operation.

ALKAFAA's industrial supply and energy-sector client environment aligns with my experience where government interfaces, regulatory discipline, responsible operations and stakeholder trust support major industrial activity.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and country-facing leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. My Saudi/GCC executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile, available with 30 days notice and open to employer-supported relocation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. (Zijin Mining Group)
